name: hochschulstart.de

coverage.includes: Medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine and pharmacy nationally, and a coordination role for some other restricted programmes.
coverage.excludes: Most bachelor programmes, which are applied for through uni-assist or the university’s own portal. There is no single German application, and assuming otherwise is the most common structural mistake made about the country.

choiceRules.note: Up to 12 study offers in the DoSV, ranked by your own priority; an application to medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine or pharmacy may name any number of locations and still counts as one. Programmes outside the DoSV are applied for separately and independently, with no shared limit.

identityRequirement: An account on the portal. Applicants with a foreign qualification normally also need a uni-assist preliminary review.
decisionModel: Places in the centrally allocated subjects are split between a grade quota, an additional-aptitude quota and university-specific selection procedures, which weigh grades alongside tests such as the TMS and sometimes relevant work. Outside those subjects, each university decides for itself, and a numerus clausus applies wherever demand exceeds places.
replyModel: Central allocation runs in coordinated rounds with fixed reply windows; outside it, each institution sets its own.
